title: Canonical scheme big fppf to small etale module comparison
statement: Fix the common-universe size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. For a scheme $U$ [def-pc-scheme], use its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site] and its structure ring $\mathcal O(T\to U)=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ from [def-sfb-scheme-big-fppf-structure-rings]. Use the small etale structure ring and Zariski extension of [def-sfb-scheme-zariski-etale-module-constructions] on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Module sheaves are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $\rho_U G$ for restriction of $G$ along $U_{\mathrm{et}}\to\mathit{Sch}/U$, with the identity map on section rings. For $g:V\to U$, let $\rho_gG(W\to V)=G(W\to V\to U)$. The small etale ring map and module direct image of [def-sfb-scheme-small-etale-module-direct-image] use $W\mapsto W\times_U V$ and pullback of functions along the first projection; let $g_{\mathrm{et}}^*$ be its canonical left adjoint, the ringed-site tensor pullback. Define $d_g:\rho_U G\to g_{\mathrm{et},*}\rho_gG$ on an etale $W\to U$ by the actual restriction $G(W)\to G(W\times_U V)$ along $\mathrm{pr}_1$. Define $c_g:g_{\mathrm{et}}^*\rho_U G\to\rho_gG$ to be its adjunction transpose. For a Zariski module with section carriers in the smaller universe, define its carrier lift sectionwise by $M(W)\mapsto\operatorname{ULift}(M(W))$, with restrictions $\operatorname{up}(M(f)(x.\operatorname{down}))$ and the transported addition and scalar action; its sheaf condition is unchanged by the inverse maps up and down. In the common module universe, Zariski extension is the same ringed-site tensor pullback along opens into the small etale site, with its canonical map on regular functions. Define $\Gamma_{\mathrm{Mod}}(U,-)$ as evaluation at $\mathrm{id}_U$ with values in abelian groups; its right derived functors use injective module resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Ring values may remain in the smaller universe while module values lie in the common universe containing the site objects; the small site module category has enough injectives. The inclusions into the big site are continuous. The open-subscheme inclusion into the small etale site is continuous; this is the existing proved continuity of that inclusion, not a new obligation. Module direct image along a continuous functor has a tensor left adjoint when module carriers lie in the maximum of the site object, site arrow and ring universes. Projection restriction preserves addition, is linear for the pulled-back scalar action, and is natural in the etale object. The carrier lift preserves sheafhood, and module evaluation is additive. These properties are the named proof obligations of the constructions, not extra data or hypotheses.
